name: GPT-4 disclosure boundary
summary: OpenAI describes GPT-4 as a Transformer-style next-token model but explicitly withholds architecture and model-size details.

stages.title: Published input boundary
stages.summary: The report establishes a next-token pre-training objective and vision capability, but not an internal topology.

stages.title: Architecture intentionally undisclosed
stages.summary: Model size, layers, widths, attention layout, hardware, training compute, and similar details are not published in the report.

stages.title: Published post-training boundary
stages.summary: The report identifies reinforcement learning from human feedback without disclosing the full training method.

stages.title: System output
stages.summary: Capabilities, limitations, and safety evaluations are published at the system boundary rather than as architecture claims.
